body: PRINT QA REPORT. Date: 2026-02-22. Files checked: shared/print.css, exam.html, index.html, shared/styles.css. RESULT: PASS with 1 gap and 1 observation. print.css is comprehensive: all interactive elements hidden (buttons, hints, score-cards, timers, graph-controls, answer-key), question cards get generous spacing (2em margin, page-break:avoid), inputs get 3em min-height for handwriting, color forced to black-on-white with print-color-adjust. GAP: index.html @media print only has .dashboard { display:none }. Dashboard prints as entirely blank page. This is intentional (dashboard is not printable content) but needs a user-facing print note. Recommend: add a print-only div with message that no printable content exists on dashboard. OBSERVATION: graph canvas on print shows raster capture of whatever Kai plotted. If no points plotted, empty canvas appears on printout. Not a bug - shows Kai's work. But empty canvas wastes 500x500px on paper. Potential fix: hide canvas in print if no points plotted (requires JS to add .graph-empty class). Low priority. PRINT CSS QUALITY: A+ for exam pages. Print CSS is one of the better-implemented areas in MCM.
